name: ai-game-studio-windows
description: A native-first Windows toolchain planner with deterministic cross-platform adaptations for Codex AI Game Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a native Windows game toolchain safely.
interface.longDescription: Inspects Windows game-development capabilities read-only, plans one native setup, and adapts POSIX-, macOS-, or Metal-bound tools without claiming binary compatibility. Downloads, installs, configuration changes, and substitutions require digest confirmation.
capabilities: Unity, Godot, Unreal, Blender, and 2D editor discovery
CUDA, DirectML, CPU, and WARP routing
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio-windows:setup-windows-edition to inspect this Windows project and propose a native setup without changes.
